videos.desc: A young man in a turquoise T-shirt and a backwards cap sits at a metal counter in a busy taqueria, with cooks working behind him. Two tacos sit on paper in front of him. He bites into a folded taco, chews with his eyes closed and his eyebrows raised, licks the sauce off his fingers, eats the second one, and finally sits back with his hand on his chest over an empty paper smeared with red sauce.

A grinning young cook in a white coat and a white cap builds a big bowl of koshari on a steel counter in a busy restaurant. He starts from a white bowl of cooked rice, tips brown lentils out of a ladle onto it, piles tubes of pasta round the edge, then pours a big ladle of red tomato sauce over the whole heap and tops it with crispy fried onions. Loose grains of rice are scattered all over the counter.

A man and a woman in clear safety goggles stand at a weathered picnic table in a sunny park with a big green striped watermelon on it. Taking turns, they stretch coloured rubber bands over the melon one at a time until dozens of them squeeze a tight belt around its middle and the fruit bulges out above and below. They lean back from the table grinning and flinching. The melon bursts: the green rind splits into curved shards and bright red flesh sprays across the whole table and out onto the grass. The two of them jump back, clench their fists and shout with delight.

A sunlit farmhouse kitchen where three generations make pizza together. A man stretches a disc of dough in the air while a small boy presses his own ball of dough on the floured worktop and a grandmother rolls out another with a wooden rolling pin. Then a woman and a man carry two finished margherita pizzas out of the oven. The scene moves outside at night to a long table under string lights, where a steaming margherita is set down in front of the whole family and everyone clinks glasses of red wine over the food.

From the edge of a tall rooftop the camera looks straight down at a car park deck far below, where a small blue water balloon falls and bursts. A grinning young man leans over the parapet holding a watermelon with the city skyline behind him, drops it, and it splatters on the concrete. Then a sack bursts on the deck and finally he tips a big water bottle over the edge and it explodes into spray far below.

A blonde young woman in a white shirt and a black waist apron smiles at the camera inside a warm, candlelit restaurant. She walks through the dining room holding leather menu folders under one arm, passing seated guests and a bar. She reaches an empty wooden table, lays the menus down on the two chairs and gestures at the table with an open hand. A couple follows her in and takes the places she has shown them while she stands beside the table.
videos.said: Right this way, best seat in the house.

videos.desc: A young baker presses a ball of pale dough on a floured wooden table while low sun pours through the window behind him. A board of dough balls is slid towards the mouth of a glowing brick oven. He wipes his floury forehead with the back of his hand in front of the fire. A tray comes out full of croissants baked to a deep golden brown, and he holds a steaming round loaf with a golden crust towards the camera.

At small round tables on the pavement outside a city cafe, an older woman with white hair sits reading a book and sipping a cup of coffee. A young man in a colourful shirt at the next table talks at her, waves his hands, leans over her book and finally holds his phone in front of her, but she never looks up from her page. He slumps back in his chair while a waiter passes behind them.

In a busy Korean barbecue restaurant a young woman in a white shirt and black apron stands at a round table grill; thick red marbled slices of beef sit on the mesh over a tall flame, ringed by dozens of small dishes of kimchi, greens and sauces. She turns and moves the slices with tongs until they brown, then lays a piece on a lettuce leaf, folds it into a parcel and holds it out to the camera while the guests behind her clap and laugh.

A young man stands at an outdoor fruit stand in front of a mosque and picks up an orange while the vendor in an apron stacks more oranges behind him. He moves on to an olive stall and takes one single olive from a big metal tray to taste it, chewing and reacting to the flavour. He then walks through a covered spice bazaar past rows of coloured spice mounds and holds up his mesh bag of oranges to the camera.

On a rooftop terrace at sunset a young woman in a denim jacket carries a tray of a dozen frosted cupcakes, cream swirls topped with chocolate, past strings of bulb lights. She sets the tray on a wooden table beside a small card that reads Welcome, walks to the glass door and knocks, then comes back, sits down alone at the table with the city skyline glowing behind her and reaches for the tray.

A woman in a blue shirt lowers a large empty white plate onto a wooden dining table by a sunny window. A serving spoon lifts rigatoni and spaghetti in tomato sauce out of a pan and sets a portion on the plate, finished with a basil leaf. The camera pulls back over a long table laid with cutlery and many identical plates of pasta, a family already seated around it in the midday light, and the woman spreads her arms to invite everyone to eat.

A run of pours in a kitchen: dark coffee streams from a carafe into a big white mug standing on the counter, pale pancake batter is poured into a black frying pan on the stove, golden syrup is drizzled over a tall stack of pancakes, and finally sparkling wine is poured into the top glass of a champagne tower.

A young woman with red braids in denim dungarees leans over a wooden garden table and pours tea from a white teapot into a small cup on a saucer, then pours orange juice from a glass jug into a row of tall glasses, and finally tips a clay pitcher of juice into a large glass bowl.

A rooftop bar at sunset. A laughing young woman in a bright patterned shirt stands behind a long counter and shakes a metal cocktail shaker beside her ear. A whole row of people along the counter shakes shakers with her in the same rhythm. Strings of light bulbs hang overhead, the sea and a pink sky are behind them, and glasses, juice bottles and steel tins stand on the counter.

A young woman in a supermarket aisle grabs cereal boxes off the shelves and throws them into her trolley as she pushes it down the aisle. The pile in the trolley grows shot by shot until, at the checkout, she stands beside a trolley stacked with a tower of cereal boxes far above her head.

A supermarket fruit section. A young woman with a dark ponytail, in a grey sweatshirt and black trousers, pushes and steers a shopping trolley piled impossibly high with a tower of whole watermelons, struggling to keep it straight. Next to her the wooden fruit display is completely empty, and watermelons lie on the tiled floor. A young shop worker in a green apron holding a clipboard stares at her, and an elderly couple watch in surprise from the aisle.

On a sunny park lawn, a young woman with a ponytail, in a blue crop top and white shorts, kneels on a grey picnic rug and holds open the lid of a cool box full of mouldy, spoiled flatbread, pulling back and grimacing. Beside her a young man in a cream t-shirt turns away and covers his nose. A yellow Labrador gets up behind them and walks off. At the end she pushes the lid of the box down. Empty plates, steel mugs and a puddle of spilled brown liquid lie on the rug.

A restaurant entrance is seen over the shoulder of a man in a black shirt. A young hostess in a burgundy cropped jumper and black skirt stands by a wooden host stand and smiles as she points across the room to a set table by the window, where a waiter in a white shirt pulls out a chair. Then she walks back to the stand and runs her finger down the open reservations book, where another hand holds a pen. Tulips in vases, a green velvet bench and pendant lamps fill the room.

Inside a small bakery, behind the glass counter, a young woman in a red top holds up two slices of cake on plates, a green pistachio layer cake and a cream cake with berries, laughs, looks from one to the other as if she cannot choose, and smiles. A young man in a navy T-shirt leans on the counter laughing, while a baker in a white apron with her hair in a bun holds an empty plate and smirks. Trays of round buns fill the display case and a pendant lamp glows above.

At an outdoor dinner on a hillside at sunset, a young woman in sunglasses and a white sleeveless dress hugs a huge armful of long baguettes and pulls a red ribbon tight around them to tie them into one bundle. A scruffy grey-brown dog reaches up for the bread at the start, and one baguette flies through the air behind her while a guest throws up her arms. Guests stand by a long table with a white cloth under paper lanterns and a vine-covered pergola.

Inside an old wooden barn lit by sunbeams through the planks, a heavy burlap sack lies open on a wooden cart with spoked wheels, and a stream of dried beans in white, cream, red, brown and black pours out of it onto the floorboards, forming a big spreading pile. Brown hens walk up and peck at the beans, and one hen flaps up onto the cart. A tabby cat sleeps on top of the other sacks, with hay and dried herbs in the background.

At a winter street-market stall at dusk under strings of warm bulbs, a smiling young woman in a cream jumper and a dark apron ladles thick, steaming chili with minced meat and beans from a huge metal pot into a paper bowl and hands it to a customer in red gloves. A bowl of chili topped with grated cheese stands on the steel counter. A basset hound in a paper chef's hat and an apron sits on a wooden crate beside the pot, and a crowd in woolly hats and scarves waits behind.

A thick stream of hot brown chocolate pours from a big ladle into a glass cup held out by a hand. On a narrow cobbled street at night in heavy rain, lit by strings of bulbs and blue neon, a barefoot woman in a gold sequin dress and a stained apron stands on a wooden cart, dips the ladle into steaming metal pots and lifts it high to pour again. All around, a crowd of people in dark raincoats and hoods hold up cups to be filled, and a man in an apron serves at the other side.

A food stand at a football stadium at night. A golden retriever in a white paper cap and a striped apron stands at the grill, holding a smoked sausage with tongs and placing it in a long bun in a paper tray. A tabby cat in a matching cap sits beside a tray of long bread rolls. A hot dog topped with fried onions and a crumpled napkin lie on the steel counter in front. Behind them laughing fans in red and white scarves watch and film under bright floodlights.

Inside a roadside diner with ceiling fans and a checkered floor, a young woman in a black leather jacket and boots stands on a red bar stool and tips back a huge glass of pink milkshake, gulping it down. Then she lowers the glass, shouts with joy and raises her fist high. A crowd of bearded bikers in leather vests cheers and points at her, a waitress in a pink uniform holding a metal jug stares and then smiles, and burgers sit on the counter.

At night at a street takeaway window under a glowing neon sign, a golden retriever in a paper cook's hat and headset leans out of the steamy window and hands a paper bag with a burger and chips to a laughing young woman in a mint helmet on a mint-green scooter. She takes the bag and lifts it high over her head with joy. Another dog in a cook's hat works in the kitchen behind, and a line of cars and scooters with headlights waits on the wet road.

A smiling young man in a navy suit stands at a candlelit table at a canal-side restaurant at night, on a wooden deck under glowing string lights, with tall brick houses and a bridge behind. He takes a plate covered with a silver dome from a cook in a white jacket in a rowing boat on the water, carries it to the table and sits down holding it, while a cloud of steam rises from under the dome. His companion, a young woman, laughs at the table, and other couples dine at white-clothed tables along the deck.

On a steep mountain slope, a young woman hiker in a red t-shirt, shorts and a backpack, with two braids and dirt on her face, crouches on wet rocks beside a thin stream of clear water running from the mossy cliff. She sips water from her cupped hands, lowers them and smiles, catches more water from the stream and drinks again, drops splashing around her. The low sun shines over the ridge behind her and a wide valley lies far below.

At night, at a long banquet table set in a red sandstone canyon under a starry sky, a smiling young chef in a white jacket and black apron and another chef carry a whole large fish baked in a crust of salt on a long wooden board. The chef holds a cleaver over the salt crust while flames flicker along the board among sprigs of herbs; then the flames die down and smoke rises. Behind him the table glows with rows of candles and lanterns, and the seated guests watch.

A sunny olive grove. A young woman with long dark hair, a rust-coloured sleeveless top and a long cream skirt stands barefoot on a wooden crate and pours a thin golden-green stream of olive oil from a clay jug held high above her head. The oil lands on a round crusty loaf held up by a young man in a white linen shirt. She lowers the jug and he lifts the oily loaf to his face and smells it. Olives lie on a net on the ground, a donkey stands behind and pickers work among the trees.

A rooftop party at dusk with city towers, strings of lights and a brown balloon floating by. A young woman in a black slip dress holds up a fork with one tiny piece of chocolate cake on it, eats it and then looks unimpressed, holding a plate with the empty fork. Next to her on the long white table stands a huge four-tier chocolate cake with burning sparklers. Her friends at the table laugh, one covering his face and one filming with a phone. Stacks of plates and a big knife lie in front.

A grand pale green dining room with a crystal chandelier and a parquet floor. A big brown bear dressed as a waiter in a white jacket and black bow tie walks slowly on its hind legs, balancing a tall, wobbly tower of stacked teacups and saucers on a tray, and brings it to a round table. A young woman in a pink suit sits at the table, holds up a hand in alarm and stares with her mouth open as the tower arrives. Other tables, potted palms and tall windows fill the room.

A small doughnut shop with mint green tiles and a checked floor. A young woman in a pink cardigan points at the rows of doughnuts in the glass display case: pink, chocolate, sugared and sprinkled ones on metal trays. Behind the counter a young man in a white T-shirt and navy apron picks one up with a pair of tongs and holds it up to her, smiling: a pink glazed doughnut with sprinkles. She gives him a thumbs up. A hot water urn, paper bags and cactus plants stand behind him.

An elegant restaurant with dark panelled walls, a crystal chandelier and green velvet chairs. A man with his hair tied back, a brown suit and an open white shirt sits at a round table with a knife and fork. On his huge white plate lies only one tiny piece of fish with a sprig of herbs. A waitress in black adds a garnish with long silver tweezers and steps away. The man looks up with a raised eyebrow, then cuts the piece and lifts the whole thing on his fork, leaving the plate empty.

A street outside a small café at sunset. A young woman in a light blue shirt and white skirt kneels on the pavement with her hands pressed together under her chin, looking up with big hopeful eyes. A young man in a white T-shirt and navy apron leans out of the café doorway, smiles and holds out a croissant on a plate, then hands it down to her and she takes it happily. A dropped paper bag and oranges lie behind her, and a woman sweeps outside the café.

A warm kitchen with brass wall lamps and a black and white tiled floor. A golden retriever in a chef's hat and apron stands up at a marble counter beside a round almond tart cut into four equal pieces. With a gold server it lifts one of the four pieces out and lays it on the white plate that a laughing young man with curly black hair, in a light blue shirt, holds out. Three pieces remain in the tin, and a frosted cake stands on a stand behind them.

A seaside promenade on a sunny day. A young woman in a blue T-shirt and white shorts kneels on the paving holding an ice cream cone, while a pink scoop drops off it through the air. A beagle sitting in front of her catches it and licks its lips. She stares at the almost empty cone, covers her cheek and starts to cry. A young man in a striped apron grins from the window of a pink and white striped kiosk. Bunting, white railings, a pier, a blue bench and a lamppost line the beach.
